methodology: Live recall runs used the plugin connection and read-only developer instructions.
Learning used a capture-only stdio MCP fixture serving real engine tool schemas and pending receipts; it has no database connection.
The fixture overrides transport in the test process, so its per-tool approval policy is copied from the user plugin policy.
Raw tool outputs and source references are retained privately outside this repository.
limitations: Small behavioral smoke test, not a golden accuracy benchmark or statistical model comparison.
Background ingestion continued; live facts were not frozen.
One latest call needed a retry after invalid arguments; tool use is not flawless.
Learning validates discovery and submission, not extraction, graph reconciliation, or eventual recall.
The synthetic write generated its own provenance identifiers; exact source timestamp fidelity is not certified.
An early fixture attempt was blocked by approval policy; corrected fixture policy was then tested successfully.
